purpose: Universal A2A+B2B marketplace substrate replacing fragmented listing, RFQ and agent-discovery surfaces while reusing the existing commerce, authority, evidence and settlement rails.
zero_fee_rule: Peer marketplace success fee remains 0% unless a separately disclosed paid service is selected.
qr_distribution: Successful toll-road/API responses may display a disclosed publisher-owned Counterclinical QR discovery surface without hidden profiling.
truth_rules: Payment intent is not settled revenue.
Only settled payment plus fulfillment and evidence can become VERIFIED revenue.
